units.source_text: 她邊說邊解下腰帶，疊放在岩石上，我也脫下披風，放在同一個地方，跟她一起跳進了大海。

en.t: As she spoke, she untied her sash, folded it on the rocks, and I took off my cloak and put it in the same place; then I jumped into the sea with her.
The woman died, but I was saved.

units.source_text: 也許因為我是一名高中生，再加上父親的名字多少有點新聞效應吧，這件事被作為重大事件刊登在報紙上。

en.t: Perhaps because I was a high school student, and because my father's name had some news value, the incident was reported in the newspapers as a major affair.

units.source_text: 我被收容在海邊的一家醫院，一位親戚還專程從老家趕來，幫我處理了很多事。

en.t: I was taken into a hospital by the sea, and a relative came all the way from my hometown to handle many things for me.

units.source_text: 這位親戚臨走前還告訴我，老家的父親和家人對此事都非常生氣，說不定會就此與我斷絕關係。

en.t: Before leaving, that relative also told me that my father and family back home were furious about the matter, and that they might cut ties with me over it.

units.source_text: 可是，比起他轉告的這些，死去的常子更讓我想念，每天啜泣著以淚洗面。

en.t: But more than any of the messages he relayed, I longed for the dead Tsuneko, and spent each day sobbing and washing my face in tears.
